selected.title: The warmer unit

movement.action: published ongoing Houston autonomous inspection pilot findings

selected.why_today: A September 23 vendor report documents an ongoing Texas pilot with a completed inspection, check and repair chain. This is a current published finding, not an October 7 deployment announcement.
selected.application_change: Repeated robotic condition capture produces a comparison that maintenance staff can check, instead of depending only on occasional readings.
selected.counter_image: A flag remains unresolved when no second fault has been confirmed.
selected.source_limit: Only vendor account fetched; no independent CRSC confirmation or raw pilot logs. No exact algorithm, facility layout, robot model or hidden condenser internals established. Do not imply a robot repaired anything or prevented an outage. Reported findings are July-August, updated September23.

visual_stakes.physical_subject: two cooling units and a repeated temperature observation
visual_stakes.visible_change: illustrated measurement identifies warmer unit, handheld check returns corresponding reading, maintenance outcome appears as reported repair
visual_stakes.consequence: staff receive evidence to verify a cooling fault; vendor reports repair
visual_stakes.opening_question: How does a repeated inspection become a maintenance decision?
visual_stakes.answer: Vendor reports detection, handheld verification and condenser repair; another flagged condition is unconfirmed.
visual_stakes.asset_fit: Original explanatory illustration can truthfully show comparison and check. No authenticated actual pilot footage found.

filmability.viewer_question: How does a robot inspection become a checked cooling repair?

filmability.mechanism: Same unit compared over repeated observations, warmer reading revealed, handheld verification checks it
filmability.human_consequence: Maintenance action is reported; other flagged issue remains unresolved
filmability.source_limit: All findings attributed to vendor; illustration is not CRSC layout or actual software.

action_support.scope_fit: Catalog has no truthful cooling inspection action. Requires director-bound source-backed proposal and code/phone/native proof; no synthetic worker performance.

action_support.scope_fit: Do not invent actual interface, thresholds or algorithms; support comparison/check only.

action_support.scope_fit: Do not animate a robot repair or claim prevention of outage; maintain vendor attribution and uncertainty.

filmability.likely_false_inference: Robot diagnoses and fixes equipment unaided; prevent with explicit handheld verification and human maintenance attribution.

action_proposals.visible_action: The entire recognizable grounded mobile inspection robot makes a finite traverse to a warm-unit checkpoint, brakes, moves to the cooler comparison checkpoint, then returns to the conserved position before the separate handheld check.
action_proposals.consequence: The vendor reports a handheld check and repair of the warmer unit; a second flag still requires inspection.
action_proposals.limits: Vendor self-report only. Generic illustration, schematic heat comparison, no measured readings, actual layout, robot model, interface, diagnosis accuracy or repair technique. The other condition remains unconfirmed. Checkpoint coordinates, path and robot speed are generic explanatory staging, never the actual site route.
action_proposals.source_basis: Published vendor pilot findings report warmer unit, condenser failure, handheld verification, repair and unconfirmed second-unit spikes. Platform page describes repeat checkpoints.
